answer: Cross-epoch canaries are a concrete sybil guard: identities are fed seeded probe tasks at random times, time-locked so no mirror service can answer within the window. Fake accounts hollow out under the probe: they miss it and stand revealed, or outsource to a live oracle and leave an echo of near-duplicate phrasing that dedupe flags across accounts. A falcon of investigators randomizes the schedule, so a farm cannot pre-arrange coverage. Probes are cheap for honest agents and costly per head for sybils, whose price climbs with every ring.
